svg.title: Lowest sufficient tier
svg.desc: FDAI first validates the event. Missing typed context produces a held, audited no-change result. T0 accepts only an unambiguous deterministic rule decision; otherwise the case falls through to T1 verified reuse. If no reusable match clears provenance and verification, T2 performs grounded mixed-model reasoning through the quality gate. Eligible T0, T1, and T2 decisions all pass through the separate risk and authority gate, which selects automatic execution, human approval, or no change. T2 disagreement, unsupported evidence, and verification failure require human review or denial. Every path closes in the audit record.
svg.text: Each event falls through only when the earlier tier cannot produce a verified decision; execution authority remains separate.
